## What changed?

Explain the writing problem and the change that addresses it.

## Why does it matter?

Describe who benefits and what the change should improve or protect.

## How was it checked?

List the package checks, behavioural cases and manual review performed.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I made one focused change and updated the changelog if users will notice it.
- [ ] I ran `python3 tests/validate_package.py`, or explained why it was unavailable.
- [ ] I added or updated a positive case and a boundary or negative case when behaviour changed.
- [ ] I did not add invented facts, sources, quotations, statistics or personal experiences.
- [ ] I preserved safeguards for voice, dialect, code-switching and non-native writing.
- [ ] I did not add detector-bypass, disclosure-concealment, guaranteed-grade or guaranteed-authorship claims.
- [ ] Detection-related changes include evidence, counterevidence, limitations and false-positive consideration.
- [ ] I used only examples that I have the right to share and removed personal or confidential information.
- [ ] Documentation uses relative links and contains no unfinished notes, fake URLs or machine-specific paths.
- [ ] I read and agree to follow the Code of Conduct.
